purpose: Single-proposal strong-model baseline to screen public task headroom. Not an interactive POMDP score or model ranking.
acceptance: Generate once from task description and selected pre-fix source; apply only exact valid edits; execute complete task oracle in CI without feedback to the model. Record all six submissions, invalid patches, transport failures and unavailable usage.
stopping_rule: Exactly six attempts; no additional probes, retries, corrected model outputs or outcome-dependent replacement. Interrupted requests stay uncertain and are not redialed.
decision: Accepted single proposals are evidence against treating these public tasks as a high-difficulty frontier set. A failed single proposal does not prove difficulty for a tool-equipped interactive agent. Keep easy tasks as regression anchors and select harder consequential tasks next.
prerequisite: All twelve artifact controls must pass before model requests. Publish source and plan first.
